notes: All times are seconds. Rows group exact layer name and visualisation type across all map views, rows, columns and layers. Each category is sorted by average draw time, highest first; ties are sorted by name. Draw count counts Draw records; averages are weighted by individual records, including logged zero durations. Draw duration already includes calculation time: do not add the two. Calculation statistics use recorded calculations associated with the following draw on the same thread, name and layer coordinates within each file. For calculations without a following draw at file end, the type is taken from earlier draws at those same coordinates if unambiguous. Cached draws may have no calculation record, so calculation count can differ from draw count. A name observed in a calculation record is a MacroParam; otherwise names ending in “ (source)” are normal parameters and remaining names are MacroParams. Missing timing values are shown as —. Six decimal places preserve small averages; input measurements retain their original precision. Each input file has its own section, including the two files dated September 28. Only logged operations are represented; partial days are not extrapolated.
